## ULB SEM Workshop | 30 October 2026

The slides from the workshop are available [here](ULB_workshops/ULB_SEM_261030.pdf) as a pdf.

The datasets for the workshopped examples are available here ([personality](ULB_workshops/data/bfi_big5.omv) and [tall poppies](ULB_workshops/data/NFI_TPS.omv)).

The *solutions* for the workshopped examples are available here ([personality](ULB_workshops/data/bfi_big5_solution.omv) and [tall poppies](ULB_workshops/data/NFI_TPS_solution.omv)).

The articles/papers mentioned in the second workshopped examples are available [here: tall poppies](ULB_workshops/articles/Feather_1989_Attitudes_towards_the_high_achiever_The_fall_of_the_tall_poppy.pdf) and [here: need for intellection](ULB_workshops/articles/Marques_et_al_2017_A_brief_scale_for_measuring_Anti-Intellectualism.pdf).
